description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes, representing tree width, and the resulting Accuracy@1 percentage for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale with a displayed range from 1 to 7, utilizing a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and employs a linear scale with values ranging from 15 to 35, marked at intervals of 5. The line representing GPT-4o is a solid, darker blue line with circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of 24.4 at an x-value of 1, increases to 28.9 at an x-value of 3, reaches a peak of 34.4 at an x-value of 5, and then declines to end at 31.1 at an x-value of 7. The line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is depicted as a solid, lighter blue line with 'x' markers; it starts at 26.7 at an x-value of 1, increases slightly to a peak of 27.8 at an x-value of 3, and then steadily declines, dropping to 24.4 at an x-value of 5 before concluding at 20.0 at an x-value of 7.
